cases.user_message: How many days do I have to request a refund?

chunks.text: Customers have **30 days** from the delivery date to request a refund. The request window is measured from the carrier's recorded delivery timestamp, not from the order-placed date.

cases.user_message: Does exception code NW-SHIP-EXC-04 apply to SKU NW-HP-1001?

policy_retrieve.query: Does exception code NW-SHIP-EXC-04 apply to SKU NW-HP-1001?

chunks.text: GOLD members may receive a one-time courtesy weather-hold refund when exception code **NW-SHIP-EXC-04** applies to SKU **NW-HP-1001**. This courtesy is a loyalty benefit, not a shipping-policy rule.
